description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.agents/workflow-kit-hook.mjs"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || for r in "$HOME/.local/share/fnm" "$HOME/AppData/Roaming/fnm" "$FNM_DIR"; do for n in "$(ls -d "$r"/node-versions/*/installation 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1)" "$r/aliases/default/installation"; do if [ -f "$n/node.exe" ] || [ -f "$n/bin/node" ]; then PATH="$n/bin:$n:$PATH"; fi; done; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" UserPromptSubmit --agent claude; exit 0
